showcase: Two whole presentations of one data set (src/data), with state kept in lib/view.js
title: Universe / Classic switch
oneLine: The switch at the top moves between the universe map and the classic pages, landing on the same place in the other; the front door opens on whichever you picked last.
howTo: Press the switch beside the wordmark in the nav.

showcase: Fuzzy-scored palette built from the same data the pages read
title: Command palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K)
oneLine: Jump anywhere on the site, or run one of its tricks: pages, projects, roles, places, themes, easter eggs, "Fly to" every map destination, links.
howTo: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows) or the search button in the nav; type a word.

title: The guide (?)
oneLine: A guide to the site and to whatever the page lets you play: its controls as a key table (keyboard or touch) and tips.
howTo: Press ? or the ? button in the corner.

title: Take the tour of the site
oneLine: A spotlight tour of the shell, one per view (ten and nine stops on a laptop); offered on a first arrival. Finishing it unlocks "Shown around".
howTo: Open ⌘K and pick "Take the tour of the site", or type tour in the terminal.

costly: Shown once a world and holds the keys until Let's go or Skip; a tour should expect it on first entry.
title: A world's basics (brief cards)
oneLine: The first time you arrive in a world, five cards say what the place is, how to move, how to do things, what to go for. Seventeen briefs in all.
howTo: Open any world for the first time, or pick "Show me the basics" in the guide.

showcase: Per-company and per-world theme tokens; custom colour keeps contrast readable (theme/custom.js)
title: Site colours (company, fan and custom)
oneLine: The dot in the menu picks a colour scheme: each company, any fan theme unlocked, or your own colour.
howTo: Open the colour dot in the nav; pick a company, a fan theme or a custom colour.

title: Theme transition scene
oneLine: The moment a theme is picked: a short scene in its own style, a line it is known for and an original sound.
howTo: Pick any colour scheme from the nav dot.

prerequisites: a fan theme unlocked and picked; not on a world page, weak device or Data Saver
title: Live backgrounds (click on empty page)
oneLine: Each fan theme brings a live background to the portfolio pages (a dogfight, Heisenberg's crystals, Iron Man's HUD, paper airplanes, invaders, diyas, Tortuga, energon, the Shire's fireworks, portals). Click on empty page for a surprise.
howTo: Unlock a fan theme, pick it, then click an empty part of a portfolio page.

title: Scroll saber
oneLine: Scroll progress along the bottom of the screen in the theme's own form: a lightsaber, Sting, a paper airplane, an energon gauge, the Infinity Stones, a test tube, a sitar string, pixels.
howTo: Scroll any page and watch the bottom edge.

title: Read the site in Aurebesh, Cybertronian or Dwarf runes
oneLine: The whole site re-reads in a script; Back to English is always at the bottom of the screen. All three is the Polyglot achievement.
howTo: Type aurebesh, cybertronian or runes anywhere, or pick it in ⌘K / the Off the clock row.

title: Konami code: jump to lightspeed
oneLine: ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A jumps to lightspeed (or the crew's own jump: Rick's portal, the RV's Blue Sky). Unlocks "Cheat code" and the Arcade theme.
howTo: Type the Konami code on any page outside an input.

title: Words typed anywhere
oneLine: Some words work typed anywhere: aurebesh, cybertronian, runes, english, saymyname, heisenberg, snap, twss, parkour, rollout, autobots, megatron, decepticons, bumblebee, shockwave, soundwave, mellon, mordor, sauron, youshallnotpass, precious, wubbalubbadubdub, schwifty, savvy, davyjones, tortuga, picklerick.
howTo: Type one of the words on any page, outside an input.

title: Say my name (Heisenberg)
oneLine: The Breaking Bad egg: the site goes Heisenberg green and the title card plays. Unlocks the Heisenberg theme.
howTo: Type saymyname, or pick "Say my name" in ⌘K.

title: Snap
oneLine: Snaps half the page away (Thanos says it). Unlocks "Perfectly balanced" and the Stark theme.
howTo: Type snap, or pick "Snap" in ⌘K.

title: That's what she said
oneLine: Michael Scott's line; unlocks "Dundie winner" and the Dunder Mifflin theme.
howTo: Type twss, or pick it in ⌘K.

title: Parkour
oneLine: The Office's parkour: the page itself does it.
howTo: Type parkour, or pick it in ⌘K.

title: Autobots, roll out (and the Decepticons)
oneLine: Transforms the site into Optimus, Megatron, Bumblebee, Shockwave or Soundwave colours; unlocks the five Transformer themes.
howTo: Type rollout, megatron, bumblebee, shockwave or soundwave, or pick "Autobots, roll out" in ⌘K.

title: Get schwifty
oneLine: The site goes portal green; unlocks "Wubba lubba dub dub" and the four Smiths' themes.
howTo: Type wubbalubbadubdub or schwifty, or pick "Get schwifty" in ⌘K.

title: Savvy? Hoist the colours
oneLine: The site goes pirate; unlocks "Savvy?" and the Black Pearl, Flying Dutchman and Tortuga themes.
howTo: Type savvy, davyjones or tortuga, or pick "Savvy?" in ⌘K.

title: Mellon, Mordor, Sauron, precious, you shall not pass
oneLine: Tolkien words typed anywhere: the Shire or Mordor theme, Gandalf, Gollum.
howTo: Type mellon, mordor, sauron, precious or youshallnotpass.

title: Pickle Rick
oneLine: Typed anywhere: Pickle Rick.
howTo: Type picklerick.

title: The hidden collectibles (eight eggs)
oneLine: A small, faint line icon tucked on each page: 1-UP (home), Mjolnir (experience), Saul's card (projects), a mug (travel), a hologram (contact), an arc reactor (résumé), a cassette (music), a lost sentence (404). Find them all for the Collector badge.
howTo: Look for the faint icon on each page and click it; the 404 one is on any address that does not exist.

title: The page that isn't there (404)
oneLine: "This isn't the page you're looking for": an Aurebesh line, the lost-sentence egg, and "Hear it from Obi-Wan".
howTo: Open any address that does not exist and press "Hear it from Obi-Wan".

title: Achievements and their toasts
oneLine: Two hundred and thirty-nine achievements, kept across visits; each unlock toasts, names the fan theme it opens and what is new in the hangar. The terminal's achievements command lists them; Scranton's Dundies hand them out.
howTo: Type achievements in the terminal to see the list.

title: Jump to lightspeed (the overlay)
oneLine: The full-screen jump, in WebGL with real depth where 3D is on.
howTo: Pick "Jump to lightspeed" in ⌘K, or type hyperspace in the terminal.

costly: About 20 s of launch before the map comes back
title: Back to the cockpit
oneLine: Replays the intro's cockpit launch from anywhere.
howTo: Pick "Back to the cockpit" in ⌘K.

title: Restart the site from the beginning
oneLine: Forgets the intro, the tour and the briefs and replays the first visit.
howTo: Pick "Restart the site from the beginning" in ⌘K, or type restart in the terminal.

title: Sound on / off
oneLine: A master volume for every clip, voice line and synthesised sound.
howTo: Pick "Turn sound on/off" in ⌘K, or type sound in the terminal.

title: Dark / light mode
oneLine: Switch between dark and light.
howTo: Pick "Switch to light mode" in ⌘K.

title: Copy email address
oneLine: Copies tilakny@gmail.com with one press, from anywhere.
howTo: Pick "Copy email address" in ⌘K.

title: Download résumé (PDF)
oneLine: The one-page PDF, from the palette, the terminal (resume pdf) or the résumé page.
howTo: Pick "Download résumé (PDF)" in ⌘K.

title: GitHub, LinkedIn, Email links
oneLine: github.com/tilakpatell, linkedin.com/in/tilakpatell, mailto.
howTo: Pick GitHub or LinkedIn under Links in ⌘K, or the footer.

title: Footer: model credits and a scene after the credits
oneLine: Every page credits the 3D models it shows (title, author, licence); the footer has a scene after the credits.
howTo: Scroll to the bottom of any portfolio or world page.

prerequisites: someone else online to see; still shows the online count alone
showcase: Serverless multiplayer: events signed with @noble/secp256k1 over Nostr relays, a protocol whitelist (online/protocol.js), a signer worker
title: Go online (multiplayer, bottom left)
oneLine: Multiplayer for the whole site over Nostr public relays with no backend: other pilots on the map and in the galaxy, ghosts in the walkable worlds, live pointers on other pages, who is online in the corner.
howTo: Press Multiplayer bottom left on the universe map (or See other players in a world).

prerequisites: online, and another visitor on the same page
title: Find me online (presence)
oneLine: Off the map, the other pilots on your page show as live pointers, unless turned off.
howTo: Go online, then open a portfolio page while someone else is on it.

showcase: A self-improving site: an autopilot loop that merges one checked change at a time and logs it
title: Changes: the ship's log
oneLine: Every change the site's autopilot has made, newest first, with a picture and how to undo it.
howTo: Open /changes (⌘K: "What's changed").

prerequisites: needs the private password; not for a public tour
deepLink: yes, but asks for the password
costly: Password-gated: a tour can only show the phone
title: The Dickansh and Deekbeggers Universe (locked)
oneLine: A world on no map or menu: a yellowed phone floating out past the home system asks for a password; the right one opens sealed exhibits and a South Indian temple gateway to a floating island.
howTo: Fly up to the phone past the home system on the map (or open /dickansh) and enter the password.

title: Home
oneLine: Intro, focus areas and a live GitHub activity snapshot; the route line draws itself down the page.
howTo: Open /home and scroll.

title: Home hero: who I am, portrait, current role
oneLine: "Technical Infrastructure PM Intern at AWS": the lead, the portrait with targeting-computer brackets, and the theme changing every few hundred pixels as you scroll.
howTo: Open /home.

showcase: A hand-built platformer, Tetris and Snake with authored courses, playable in page
title: The Game Boy on the home page (three games)
oneLine: A DMG-style handheld with a cartridge of three games: Super Tilak Land (four worlds, a fire flower, a king at the castle), Block Drop and Snake. Every game keeps its best score; 10 coins, the king and a four-line clear are achievements.
howTo: Scroll to the Game Boy and press Start (Enter); arrows, Z/Space for A, X for B.

title: The route line
oneLine: The scroll-drawn connector that runs down every page, lighting each stop; on home a career strip, one stop per employer in its company colour.
howTo: Scroll /home slowly.

title: Home: hackathon, open source and systems code
oneLine: The featured projects, Claude translating a page live, and the focus areas (infrastructure and capacity, AI pipelines and agents, systems and performance).
howTo: Scroll to "A winning hackathon build" and "Close to the infrastructure".

title: Home: toolkit
oneLine: What I build with: languages, frameworks, tools and platforms.
howTo: Scroll to "What I build with".

showcase: Reads the public GitHub API live; a build-time snapshot as fallback (prebuild)
title: Live GitHub snapshot
oneLine: A live GitHub activity snapshot on the home page (and github in the terminal: repos, top languages, recently pushed).
howTo: Scroll /home to the GitHub block, or type github in the terminal.

title: Off the clock: the dock and the fandom cards
oneLine: A row of small icons, each does something (the sitar plays a flourish, the Falcon jumps to the Death Star, the gauntlet snaps, Gandalf opens the doors), and one interactive card per fandom; the way into the universe map.
howTo: Scroll to the bottom of /home and press the icons; open a card.

title: The sitar card (playable, Raga Yaman)
oneLine: A sitar you can play with real recorded notes retuned to Yaman's frets, a tanpura drone, meend by dragging; keys 1 to 8.
howTo: Click a fret on the sitar card, or press 1 to 8.

title: The Breaking Bad title card with my name
oneLine: Ti (titanium) and Pa (protactinium) are real elements.
howTo: Say my name (type saymyname) on /home.

title: The six pages are one feed
oneLine: Scroll to the end of any portfolio page and the next begins under it; the address, the menu and the theme follow. After the sixth, an end card.
howTo: Keep scrolling past the end of /home.

showcase: Six themed sections, one motif diagram per role drawn from the work (Motifs.jsx)
title: Experience
oneLine: Every role, AWS to SRC; the whole site takes on each company's colours as its role scrolls past. Seeing all six is the Cartographer achievement.
howTo: Open /experience and scroll.

title: AWS: Technical Infrastructure PM Intern
oneLine: Data-center planning tools for generative-AI capacity; a Python multi-agent pipeline over Redshift via MCP.
howTo: Open /experience/aws.

title: RTX: Application Transformation Intern
oneLine: The application-modernization value stream and roadmap behind RTX's 2028 goals; workloads onto Xeta Cloud.
howTo: Open /experience/rtx.

title: Bose: Software Engineer Co-op
oneLine: A log-analysis platform (60+ FastAPI endpoints, a three-phase pipeline with 25+ tools) and a React/Electron/Copilot SDK desktop app.
howTo: Open /experience/bose.

title: Pendar: Laser Software Engineer Co-op
oneLine: A real-time Qt/PySide6 acquisition app that fully replaced a LabVIEW system.
howTo: Open /experience/pendar.

title: Empowerreg AI: AI Engineer Intern
oneLine: FDA complaint-severity heatmaps, a Grafana and Loki stack, an assistant saving 4+ hours a week.
howTo: Open /experience/empowerreg.

title: SRC: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
oneLine: Knowledge triplets from 500+ radar documents at 90% accuracy into LangGraph knowledge graphs.
howTo: Open /experience/src.

title: Experience: filter by track (?track=pm)
oneLine: Highlight program management or engineering roles; the pick lives in the address so a link can open on it.
howTo: Open /experience?track=pm or press the track buttons.

costly: A minute-long crawl; it has a Skip button (OpeningCrawl.jsx:103)
title: Play the opening crawl
oneLine: The opening crawl for the whole story so far.
howTo: Press "Play the opening crawl" under the current role.

title: The program-management side, step by step
oneLine: Discover, Plan, Build, Deliver, Measure, each step taken from a role, then the toolkit.
howTo: Scroll /experience to the program section.

title: The Dundies for real results
oneLine: The Office's awards night, for real results: every award a line from the roles.
howTo: Scroll /experience to the awards.

showcase: Three.js cartridges as navigation
title: Projects
oneLine: Opens on a hand of 3D game cartridges, one per project: point at one to lift it, click to open it. Case studies, each with a live demo.
howTo: Open /projects; point at a cartridge and click.

title: The periodic table of the stack
oneLine: Click a tile to light up the projects built with it.
howTo: Click a tile in the periodic table on /projects.

title: The sitar string divider
oneLine: A section break drawn as a sitar string; click it and it plays a note.
howTo: Click the string between sections on /projects.

showcase: C++/SDL3 emulator; the in-page CPU stepper and PPU scanline demo explain the architecture
title: Game Boy Emulator (project page)
oneLine: All 500+ LR35902 opcodes, a scanline PPU, 60 FPS, passes Blargg's CPU tests. Stages: play it, step the CPU, watch the PPU draw, pass the tests.
howTo: Open /projects/gameboy-emulator and try the stages top to bottom.

showcase: Retryable staged pipeline in Postgres, prompt caching, a 247-term glossary
title: Swaminarayan Translator (project page)
oneLine: An AI translation workbench for scanned Gujarati, Hindi and Sanskrit books: OCR, layout, page-by-page translation with Claude. Stages: translated with Claude, one page through the pipeline.
howTo: Open /projects/swaminarayan-translator.

title: DevSpace (HackBeanpot 1st place)
oneLine: A collaborative cloud IDE with GPU-accelerated Docker on a Jetson Nano. Stages: edit together, edit and run a CUDA kernel, share one GPU.
howTo: Open /projects/devspace and edit the kernel in "Your turn".

title: github/awesome-copilot (merged PR)
oneLine: Error-recovery hooks and PyInstaller recipes merged into GitHub's 39K-star repository. Stages: upstream, what the hook does.
howTo: Open /projects/awesome-copilot.

title: Unix Shell (try it in the browser)
oneLine: A small shell running in your browser: pipes, redirection and the classic text tools. Type help.
howTo: Open /projects/unix-shell and type a command in "Try it".

title: FUSE File System
oneLine: A userspace file system in C. Stages: mount it, make some files (inodes, blocks, a bitmap).
howTo: Open /projects/fuse-fs.

title: Finance Platform API
oneLine: FastAPI + MongoDB. Stages: call it, pick a risk level.
howTo: Open /projects/finance-platform and drag the risk slider.

title: Smart Summarizer
oneLine: BERT summarisation. Stages: summarise anything, what the model looks at (attention).
howTo: Open /projects/smart-summarizer and paste text.

title: GPU Checkpoint-Restart (research)
oneLine: With Prof. Gene Cooperman: checkpoint-restart for NCCL collectives on MANA. Stages: four GPUs in a ring, flamegraphs.
howTo: Open /projects/gpu-checkpoint-restart.

title: Résumé
oneLine: The résumé on the page, filterable by skill, with the PDF a click away; opening it is the "Recruited" achievement.
howTo: Open /resume; click a skill to light up every line that uses it; the PDF tab has the one-page version.

showcase: A dotted 3D globe (npm run globe) with lazy WebGL
title: Travel
oneLine: Fifteen countries and the Caribbean on a globe to spin, with photos from each; /travel?place=is flies to Iceland.
howTo: Open /travel, drag the globe, click a place.

title: Contact
oneLine: A paper airplane folded from the memo pad; send the memo and it takes off. The form opens your email app; nothing is sent from the page.
howTo: Open /contact, fill the memo, press send.

showcase: Three.js map, flight model (ship.js), procedural planets and atmospheres, all on a static site
title: The universe map (the front door)
oneLine: The whole site as places in space: the six pages are stations round a sun, each fandom a planet out in the dark. Fly to a planet to open its page.
howTo: Open / (or /universe); pick a ship, then W to throttle, arrows to turn.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
deepLink: no (needs the first-visit flag tp-intro unset)
costly: Welcome + crawl + cockpit is about 90 s; Skip on the welcome and "Skip intro" on the crawl exist
title: First visit: welcome, crawl, cockpit, launch
oneLine: A first visit opens with a welcome, then a crawl, then puts you in a cockpit (Han's seat with Chewie beside you) and you punch it into the map.
howTo: Visit as a new visitor (or ⌘K "Restart the site from the beginning").

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The front door's choice
oneLine: Over the universe on a first arrival: fly through the site, or go straight to the home page. Remembered unless told not to.
howTo: Pick one on the first arrival at /.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Pick a ship (four crews)
oneLine: Rick and Morty's cruiser, Luke and Artoo's X-wing, Han and Chewie's Falcon or Walt and Jesse's RV. Each crew has a word about every place. No ship? Pick a place and the camera flies there.
howTo: Open the ships in the panel on the map and pick one.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Fly the ship
oneLine: W/S throttle, A/D roll, arrows turn and pitch, Space/Shift boost (the pulse drive out in the open), drag to fly like a stick; on a phone, drag anywhere and tap a place.
howTo: Hold W and steer with the arrows.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Cockpit view (V)
oneLine: Every ship has its own cockpit, with the crew aboard.
howTo: Press V while flying.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Pure-data routing with trip times, tested in Node (nav.test.js)
title: The nav map (M): drives and trip times
oneLine: Everywhere on one chart: pick a place and a drive (hyperspeed, a jump; super speed, 3× the pulse drive; or cruise), with the trip time for each. The galaxy's star systems are on it too. Copy a link to any place.
howTo: Press M, pick a place, pick a drive, Go.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Deep links to any place (/universe/<id>)
oneLine: Every place has a link that opens the map there (/universe/aurelia, say); the terminal's fly <place> and ⌘K's "Fly to" do the same.
howTo: Open /universe/aurelia.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Jump (J) at hyperspeed, each crew its own way
oneLine: The X-wing and the Falcon go to lightspeed, Rick's cruiser through a portal, Walt and Jesse's RV crystallises into Blue Sky and shatters out at the other end.
howTo: Pick a place on the nav map with Hyperspeed, then J.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The grand tour (nav map: Tour)
oneLine: Every station, world and wonder, nearest first, the crew talking; Escape stops it. Finishing it is "Seen it all".
howTo: Press M, then Tour.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Power-budgeted outfitting (outfit.js) whose numbers feed the flight model
title: The hangar (H): paint and parts
oneLine: Fit the ship out like a space sim's outfitting screen: paint jobs (the six companies' with Cartographer, each fan scheme's with its egg), boosters, thrusters, guns, shields, fins; each draws power and adds mass. Other pilots see it.
howTo: Press H on the map; pick a tab and a part.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Procedural ship generation from a seed, modelled in code (universe/shipyard/)
title: The shipyard: build your own ship
oneLine: Fly the crew's own ship, or a garage build of your own: a hull (Dart, Saucer, Hauler, Needle), cockpit, wings, engines, tail and extras snapped onto sockets, rolled from a seed the way No Man's Sky does, or picked by hand; a code (GB-021301.k3) passes it on.
howTo: Press H, open the Build tab, press Roll.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Flight settings (O)
oneLine: Steering, aim assist, lock tracking, inverted pitch and more.
howTo: Press O on the map.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Three guns: blaster, spread, heavy ordnance
oneLine: Every ship carries three guns in its crew's terms: a blaster, a spread of five shots, and heavy ordnance (proton torpedoes, concussion missiles, portal grenades, fulminated mercury) that homes on the lock, from a rack of four.
howTo: Hold F to fire; R or 1 2 3 to change weapons; T/Q to cycle targets.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The six stations (Home, Experience, Projects, Résumé, Contact, Terminal)
oneLine: The portfolio's pages as stations round the sun, each with a big sign ("EXPERIENCE: Six roles, AWS to SRC"). Dock (E) to open the page; brush one and you bounce off.
howTo: Open /universe/experience and press E (or Enter) at the station.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Atmospheric entry and a seamless hand-off to an on-foot scene per planet
title: Land on a planet (fly down into its air)
oneLine: Come in at a normal speed and you are taken in: the hull burning, the planet's sky coming up, through the clouds, and out over its landing, where the ship sets down and the crew step out.
howTo: Fly slowly down into the glow round a planet.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Crash into a planet (boosting) to open its world
oneLine: Come in boosting and there is no landing: it is a crash, and the crash takes you into the planet's world page.
howTo: Hold Space (boost) straight into a planet.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: On foot at a landing (W A S D, X swaps crew, G through a door)
oneLine: Walk, run, jump and fire; X switches to the other one of your crew, V looks out of their eyes, B is Rick's next gadget (portal gun, freeze ray, shrink ray), G takes you through the landing's door into the world's page or back into the ship.
howTo: Land, then W A S D to walk; G at the door.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Thirteen landings, each under its own sky
oneLine: The Shire on the party day, the desert where the RV cooks, the Smiths' street, Kaon's towers, the Avengers compound, the lot behind Dunder Mifflin, Dot Matrix in four greens, the music courtyard, an airfield on Earth, a Caribbean beach with the Black Pearl, the Graysons' city, the Death Star's trench. People stand about with a line (Gandalf, Saul, Jerry, Dwight, Thor, Jack…).
howTo: Land on each planet in turn and walk up to its people and its door.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Shader-drawn stars, nebulae, a black hole with lensing (deepspaceShaders.js)
title: Deep space: the wonders
oneLine: Aurelia (ringed gas giant), Glacia (ice giant), Ember and Halcyon (suns with worlds), the Maw (black hole), the Veil and the Cradle (nebulae to fly through), the Lantern (pulsar), the Twins (binary), the Wanderer (rogue planet), the Graveyard (wreck field), a rim of ice round the map. The crew have a word about each.
howTo: Open /universe/aurelia, /universe/ember, /universe/wanderer… or pick them on the nav map under Wonders.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
costly: Leaves the site for another one
title: The black hole: through to a friend's universe
oneLine: The one thing out there you don't come back from. On its far side is Shrey Pathak's portfolio (the Matrix); Back brings you home.
howTo: Fly into the Maw past the nav computer's stop.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The green portal to the Rick and Morty sector
oneLine: Beside the Rick and Morty planet hangs a green portal: fly into it and you come out in a sector of its own with the Citadel of Ricks at its heart, eight worlds from the show, a green-tinged sun and the Central Finite Curve round its edge. The Citadel's own portal takes you home.
howTo: Open /universe/rmportal and fly into it (or pick any sector place on the nav map).

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The eight Rick and Morty moons (land on each)
oneLine: Gazorpazorp, Planet Squanch, Bird World, Gear World, Pluto, Snake Planet, Nuptia 4 and the Immortality Field Resort, each landed on like a planet, with a portal on the ground back to C-137 dialled to that world.
howTo: Open /universe/squanch (or any moon id) and fly down into it.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
showcase: Serverless shared world state: per-pilot damage shares summed identically in every browser (universe/siege.js)
costly: Several minutes of fighting with the Council's hunters on you
title: Bring down the Citadel of Ricks (shared siege)
oneLine: Knock out the four shield generators on its arms, then only heavy ordnance hurts the core; it goes up in fire and portal fluid for everyone online, and the Ricks bring it back five minutes later. Shared without a server: each pilot speaks only for their own damage.
howTo: Fly to the Citadel, shoot the four domes, then torpedo the core.

title: Shoot down the NX-5 Planet Remover
oneLine: In Rick's universe the Federation drops its Planet Remover out of warp beside the planet you are at, its ring cannon charging; shoot it down or watch the planet go dark for a minute.
howTo: Fly Rick's cruiser near a planet and wait for it; shoot it before it fires.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Hunters, Star Destroyers and bounty hunters
oneLine: The Empire, the Galactic Federation or the Council of Ricks come after you; a Star Destroyer drops out of hyperspace and launches fighters (knock out its shield domes, then its bridge); Boba Fett in Slave I or Phoenixperson comes for you alone ("Wanted").
howTo: Fly about and shoot things; hunters come sooner if you have been shooting.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Happenings: convoys, distress calls, flares, rifts, purrgil, rocks
oneLine: Someone calls for help with pirates on their tail, a convoy goes by, a comet crosses, a star flares and rattles the ship, a rift opens (fly in and it drops you elsewhere: "Through the rift"), purrgil or a Cromulon swim past, rocks cross your path.
howTo: Cruise in deep space and answer what comes; fly into a rift.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Friends come to help, and freighters under attack
oneLine: When hunters have been on you a while a wing of friends comes up from behind (X-wings, Birdperson) and peels away once the sky is clear; out ahead a freighter is under attack: fly in and help and its crew thank you.
howTo: Get into a fight and hold on; fly toward the flashes.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The universe keeps score (hero, wanted, shunned)
oneLine: Shoot freighters and the ordinary ships run and merchants shun you; cross the law and every scan finds you wanted; save people and they call you a hero.
howTo: Shoot a freighter, or rescue one, and listen to the comms.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: Three fleet wars on the universe map (Star Wars, Rick and Morty, Breaking Bad)
oneLine: Each crew's universe has a war with fronts at real places: the Federation's battleship and the Council's dreadnought, Gus's superlab barge and Don Eladio's hacienda; the nav map shows the front and the trip to it; you are put in on your crew's side.
howTo: Press M and pick the war's front.

title: Other pilots in your sky (fly together or shoot each other)
oneLine: Everyone else on the map is there in their own ships with their paint and parts; land where someone is down and your crews walk about together; two Ricks meet as Ricks from another dimension.
howTo: Go online (bottom left) and look for the others' markers.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The crew's comms
oneLine: Each crew has a word about every place, wonder, hunter and happening, many in their own voices.
howTo: Fly anywhere and read the comms line.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The hyperspace gate to the Star Wars galaxy
oneLine: Star Wars isn't a planet but a galaxy of its own, the galaxy in miniature behind a gate the Empire's Star Destroyers guard; fly into it and you jump to lightspeed into /galaxy.
howTo: Open /universe/starwars and fly into the gate.

title: The floating phone (the way to Dickansh)
oneLine: A yellowed Pixel that says SAMSUNG gAlaxy floats out past the home system between the Office and Music; click it or fly up to it and it asks for a password.
howTo: Fly above the disc out past the home system toward the Office/Music gap and click the phone.

prerequisites: WebGL; a ship picked (or the camera flies you)
title: The map's first flight (basics cards)
oneLine: The stick, getting about, landing and trouble, and the panel's ?, shown once the first time a ship is under you.
howTo: Pick a ship for the first time.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
showcase: A second whole flight world sharing the ship, with a synchronised shared clock for the moments (online)
title: A galaxy far, far away
oneLine: Eighteen star systems from the films and the shows, each a moment from them playing out round you (Death Squadron over Hoth, the Battle of Endor, the Razor Crest with a TIE on its tail). Every pilot online sees the same moment.
howTo: Open /galaxy (or fly into the gate); fly with the universe's keys.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Jump to lightspeed between systems (J)
oneLine: Every other system's star is in the sky where it really is; put the nose on it and press J, or fly out of the system toward it.
howTo: Turn the nose to a star until its name comes up, then J.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: The galaxy map (M): plot a course, filter by era or film
oneLine: A holotable: the disc, the regions, the atlas grid A to U, the great hyperspace routes, every system in its colour with its era, films, distance, jump time and who is flying there now.
howTo: Press M in the galaxy; pick a system; Jump.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: The Interdictor (every 10 to 15 jumps)
oneLine: An Imperial Interdictor cruiser pulls you out of hyperspace short of where you were going, its TIEs launch, and the hyperdrive won't take until you are clear of the well. "Interdicted".
howTo: Keep jumping; between the tenth and fifteenth jump it bites. Shoot the fighters or run for the well's edge.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
showcase: A shared persistent war on a static site: a tally protocol over Nostr where every pilot's history agrees (warState.js)
title: The three wars (holotable): swear to a side, rise in rank
oneLine: The Clone Wars, the Galactic Civil War and the Remnant War at once on the same map, Helldivers-style, by everyone online; fronts move along the trade routes, the Hutts raid, whoever holds a system decides who hunts you there; commanders call you by rank. Five achievements (Sworn, Liberator, Major order, Turncoat, Top brass).
howTo: Press M, open the war tab, pick a war and swear to a side; fight the battle nearest you.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
deepLink: partial (a battle has to be on there)
title: Fleet battles with set pieces (Endor, Hoth, Scarif)
oneLine: Each system fights its own kind of battle (siege, evacuation, interdiction, blockade, ambush): the shield generator holds the Death Star's shield up, the superlaser fires on Rebel cruisers, the Executor dives into the station, the ion cannon disables Star Destroyers, the Hammerhead rams the Shield Gate, hangar runs into a reactor.
howTo: Arrive at a system where a battle is on (the holotable says) and lock onto the objective.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Outlaws: hunters, a Star Destroyer and bounty hunters in the galaxy
oneLine: The galaxy has its own hunters (the navy, Fett, IG-88, Bossk, Dengar, Weequay pirates, Hondo) and who holds a system decides who flies escort.
howTo: Fly about a system and shoot something.

title: Other pilots in the same system
oneLine: The other pilots in the same system are there with you; the galaxy map shows how many are where.
howTo: Go online, press M and see the counts.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
costly: Each crawl runs about a minute
title: Mission briefings with their own opening crawls
oneLine: Every system's mission as a holotable briefing: its opening crawl (a button plays it, with the main title), who you play, what you are up against, the three things to do and how it flies; the live ones go straight in.
howTo: Open /galaxy/<system>/mission, press the crawl button.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
showcase: Seventeen procedural terrains with seas (Gerstner shader), weather, Bruno-Simon-style baked light
title: Land on a world (E): 17 surfaces to walk
oneLine: Every planet from the films you can stand on (all but Alderaan): your ship comes down, you and your crewmate climb out onto the sand, the snow, the forest floor, a platform over Bespin's clouds. Places from the films on a compass until found, people and creatures to talk to, speeders and tauntauns to ride. "Boots on the ground", "Surveyor", "Wanderer".
howTo: Press E at a planet in the galaxy, or open /galaxy/<system>/surface.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Play as: Luke, Leia, Han, Chewie, Ahsoka, Boba Fett (and Rick, Morty, Walt, Jesse)
oneLine: The button with your name on it: pick who you play as; for a Jedi the blade's colour, the hilt and the stance (single, double, dual, crossguard); for the rest the gun and two mods; three perks for anyone, Battlefront's star cards in spirit.
howTo: On a surface, press the name button top right and pick a hero.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
showcase: Enemies with perception and squad tactics (lib/ai: utility, trees, context steering)
title: Lightsaber and blaster combat on the ground
oneLine: Strokes chain, F held is the heavy stroke, C blocks (a block as a swipe lands is a parry), R throws the saber, X dodges, G Force push or a thermal detonator, V Force pull or overcharge; guns heat up, vent early; duellists have a guard to break.
howTo: Pick a Jedi, find a trooper and fight.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Rides: speeders, speeder bikes, tauntauns, kaadu, banthas
oneLine: Things to ride on a world: throttle and steer with W A S D, Shift to boost, E to get off.
howTo: Walk up to a speeder or a tauntaun and press E.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Swap to your crewmate (Tab)
oneLine: Play the other of your crew down on a world.
howTo: Press Tab on a surface.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Coruscant, Yavin 4 and Bespin: whole places with interiors
oneLine: Coruscant (the Temple and its Archives, the Senate, Dex's diner, the Outlander club), Yavin 4 (the Great Temple's hangar, war room and throne room: the briefing, the scramble, the medal ceremony) and Bespin (Cloud City's platforms, the dining room, the carbon-freezing chamber, the reactor gantry): people with wants who say different things by who holds the world.
howTo: Open /galaxy/yavin/surface and walk into the Great Temple.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
showcase: A seeded, pure, tested battle sim (assault.test.js) balanced by AI-only runs; Battlefront 2 Remaster models imported with permission
title: Galactic assault (Battlefront-style command posts)
oneLine: Two armies and the command posts between them, you one soldier among them; squads flank, take cover and come back in waves; pick a side and a post, hold a post with more of yours than theirs and it turns, take every post of the phase and the next begins. Hoth, Geonosis, Scarif, Endor, Yavin 4, Cloud City, Coruscant.
howTo: Open /galaxy/hoth/surface?mission=assault, pick a side and deploy.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Side quests on the surfaces (talk to the people)
oneLine: Scarif: walkers on the beach, Rogue One calling. Endor: the speeder-bike chase, the shield bunker, quiet in the ferns, the Ewoks' war, an older code. Kashyyyk: the beachhead, a way off-world. Dagobah: size matters not, the cave. Naboo: the Great Grass Plains, a kaadu run. Kamino: the bounty hunter. Geonosis: the Petranaki arena, the droid foundry, Count Dooku, the nearest starship.
howTo: Walk up to a named person (a Rebel scout, Yoda, Mace Windu, Taun We) and press E.

prerequisites: WebGL; downloads ~8 MB (WORLD_MB) plus a few MB a world
title: Tatooine: Greedo, Docking Bay 94, the rancor, Jabba's bounty, womp rats, Tosche Station
oneLine: Don't let Greedo shoot first in the cantina, hold off the stormtroopers at Docking Bay 94, bring the gate down on the rancor, collect a bounty from Boba Fett, bullseye womp rats in Beggar's Canyon, pick up power converters at Tosche Station.
howTo: Land on Tatooine, find Mos Eisley and the palace on the compass, talk to whoever is there.

title: The Death Star
oneLine: That's no moon. Fire the superlaser, or fly the trench run before Yavin 4 comes into range. Opening it is "Fully operational".
howTo: Open /deathstar (terminal: deathstar; the footer; the Konami code).

title: Fire the superlaser
oneLine: Fire it, or set a course to another planet first.
howTo: Press Fire on the station's hero; pick a planet to target first.

title: The Battle of Yavin (a clock)
oneLine: Set course for Yavin 4 and a clock starts: fly the trench run before the moon is in range. "Medal of Yavin" if you save it, "Fear will keep them in line" if the Empire fires first.
howTo: Set course for Yavin 4, then scroll to the trench run and fly it.

showcase: A hand-written 2D game with its rules pure and tested (trench.js, trench.test.js); runs without WebGL
title: The trench run (2D canvas, no GPU needed)
oneLine: Shoot the TIEs and towers over the surface, dive in, dodge the catwalks, shoot the turrets, lose Vader, torpedo the port when it turns green. Rookie, Red Five or Jedi; targeting computer off (T) is half again on the score. "Use the Force".
howTo: Open /deathstar#trench; W A S D steer, hold Space for lasers, F for a torpedo.

title: The technical readout (the stolen plans)
oneLine: A cutaway of the station: every numbered part opens what happened there in the film, with the scene's clip or the line in its speaker's voice.
howTo: Scroll to the readout and press a numbered part.

title: The Death Star soundboard and Aurebesh toggle
oneLine: The films' lines, then their sounds; read the page in Aurebesh.
howTo: Scroll to the soundboard; press the Aurebesh toggle.

showcase: A diorama map modelled in code with a figure walking the road (mapDiorama.js, road.js)
title: Middle-earth: the tabletop map of the Ring's road
oneLine: A 3D map of chapters: pick a stop and the camera flies down to it; a wax seal marks each place won; the road so far (seals, side stars, kitchen stars) reads on the map.
howTo: Open /middle-earth and click a pin.

title: The Shire (a stop on the road, walked as Frodo)
oneLine: Hobbiton on Bilbo's birthday: Maggot's mushrooms, a smoke with Gandalf, the fireworks, the Ring in Bag End's fire, hiding from a Black Rider; Bilbo's spoons on the side. Seals: mushrooms, smokerings, fireworks, secretsafe, getoffroad (+ spoons).
howTo: Open /middle-earth/shire; W A S D walk, E does what the prompt says, M lists things to do.

title: Bree (a stop on the road, walked as Frodo)
oneLine: The Prancing Pony on a wet night: the West Gate, Mr. Underhill, Pippin's pints, Strider, the lanes past the Nazgûl; a song on the table on the side. Seals: breegate, underhill, pints, strider, slipaway (+ maninthemoon).
howTo: Open /middle-earth/bree; W A S D walk, E does what the prompt says, M lists things to do.

title: Weathertop (a stop on the road, walked as Frodo)

howTo: Open /middle-earth/weathertop; W A S D walk, E does what the prompt says, M lists things to do.

costly: Needs a ROM the tour cannot supply
title: Super Mario 64 on a real N64 emulator (your own ROM)
oneLine: A Nintendo 64 emulated in the browser (EmulatorJS's mupen64plus core) running the visitor's own ROM (.z64/.n64/.v64), kept on the device; keys laid out for Mario, controllers and touch; save states and full screen.
howTo: Open /dot-matrix/64 and give it a ROM file.
prerequisites: the visitor's own ROM (the site hosts no games); downloads ~7 MB

showcase: A rigged Mario posed for every move, PBR CC0 textures, IBL, bloom; original synthesised music

title: The Super Mario 64 fan tribute (Peach's castle, Bob-omb Ridge)
oneLine: Peach's castle grounds and inside, paintings into worlds, star doors; Mario moves as on the N64 (triple jump, backflip, long jump, wall kick, dive, ground pound, swimming); Bob-omb Ridge: King Bob-omb, eight red coins, the Chain Chomp, three stars of fifteen; Modern, Ultra or the N64's own look. "Superstar".

showcase: Client-side sealed assets on a static host with a cross-origin player frame; an adversarial review with 18 findings fixed
title: Minecraft itself (Eaglercraft 1.12.2 and 1.8.8), behind a password
oneLine: The real client compiled to JavaScript, its files sealed with the password (AES-GCM from PBKDF2) and opened in the browser in a walled-off frame; worlds saved on the device, shared worlds to import, Open to LAN through Eaglercraft's relays.
howTo: Open /dot-matrix/minecraft and enter the password.
prerequisites: the private password; a 23 MB download

showcase: Chunked voxel engine in a worker with the game's own lighting and tick rules, 125+ rule tests
title: The Minecraft fan tribute (no password)
oneLine: An endless seeded world of one-metre blocks (nine biomes, the sea at 63) generated and meshed in a worker with the game's corner shading; walk, sprint, sneak, jump, swim at 20 ticks a second; dig, build, craft (2×2 and 3×3), a 20-minute day, torches, a bed, caves, ores, flowing water and lava, a furnace, a chest, hunger and death; saved on the device. Textures used with Mojang's permission.
howTo: Open /dot-matrix/minecraft without the password; click the world, dig a tree.

showcase: 6,700 towers and 5,500 houses painted in the shader from a seeded map; a 14 km shader-painted ground
title: Invincible: fly the Graysons' city as Mark
oneLine: Six kilometres of downtown, river, suburbs and coast; through the sound barrier (a boom past 430 km/h), into the ground hard enough to crack it, bouncing off towers, and up out of the air into space. The first visit drops Mark in under the title card.
howTo: Open /invincible; W A S D fly, Space up, Shift flat out, C down.

title: Dad's rings (a flight lesson against the clock)
oneLine: Ten rings from the house to the Guardians' hall, flown in order against the clock; the best time kept. "Flight lesson".
howTo: Fly through the first ring over the street outside the house.

title: The eight hidden title cards
oneLine: The first season's eight title cards hidden round the city (one high up), each with a shaft of light. "The whole season".
howTo: Look for the shafts of light and fly through the cards.

title: Rescues (follow the red beacon)
oneLine: Every minute or so someone needs catching: a person on a roof edge, a news helicopter spinning down; catch them, land to set them down. "That actually helped".
howTo: Follow the red beacon when it appears.

title: Fly alongside the airliner
oneLine: An airliner goes round the city at 1,400 m; fly alongside and your father has something to say. "A fraction of our power".
howTo: Climb to 1,400 m and match the airliner.

title: The Flaxans (a portal over the river)
oneLine: They come through a portal over the river when Cecil sends you (E at the GDA) or a few minutes in; punch them out of the sky or fly into them; all twelve down and the portal closes. "Back through the portal".
howTo: Press E at Cecil outside the GDA, then fly to the river.

title: Up into space: the Moon and Mars
oneLine: Keep climbing past 9 km and you are out of the air with the Earth under you; flat out you go twenty times faster; land on the Moon and Mars (someone waits at each); dive back and you come down through fire. "Neil Armstrong, eat your heart out", "One small step", "A long way from home".
howTo: Hold Space and Shift and keep climbing; follow the gauge to the Moon.

title: Break the sound barrier
oneLine: Past about 430 km/h the air breaks with a boom, a vapour cone and shock rings. "Here goes nothing".
howTo: Hold Shift in a straight line.

title: Think, Mark! (the game: four chapters)
oneLine: Flight lesson, the Flaxans, Omni-Man, Thragg: a Viltrumite blocks and hits back unless he is recovering from a charge; dodge as the ring closes, then hit him; a last-moment dodge slows everything down. "Think, Mark!", "Invincible".
howTo: Open /invincible#inv-game (or E by Dad); W A S D, J punch, K dodge, Tab target.

howTo: Scroll to the files and drag.

oneLine: Each card's line said aloud in its voice, and Mark's answer; the title card has a rough season (press it for the next episode).
howTo: Scroll to the lines and press a card; press the title card.
